method: Each record opened through its repository API (Zenodo, GBIF, Mendeley Data, Harvard Dataverse, Figshare, Dryad); other repositories through DataCite metadata. 'data' = at least one data file (table, archive, images, sequences, GIS …) or a GBIF dataset with records; 'article' = only PDF/Word/slides; 'code' = only code and documents. Records in data-only repositories without a file API (PANGAEA, Science Data Bank, VizieR, ICPSR, GESIS …) were counted as data after their landing page opened; 11 pages blocked automated access and are counted on the repository's nature.
